title: Rollout toolbar: compact focus order & translation-ready states
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Small-screen rollout toolbar in the Console currently has inconsistent focus order, missing focus ring on compressed controls, and untested/fragile states when strings expand in other locales. This ticket proposes a prototype and a focused accessibility + localization audit to ensure the toolbar is keyboard usable, resilient to long translations, and maintains contrast in both compact and expanded states.
background: Rollouts toolbar is used widely in the Console top-right on dashboards and variant pages. We observed two bugs in user testing: tabbing jumps from a variant chip into the page content (skips toolbar controls), and in Spanish locale the 'New Variant' label truncates and overlaps the adjacent toggle, causing touch targets to collapse. Engineering also reported flaky visual tests when color tokens changed between themes.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard: Tab order cycles predictably through toolbar controls (left-to-right logical order), Shift+Tab reverses order; focus is never lost into background content.
Focus styling: All controls have a 2px focus ring using accessible contrast tokens; high-contrast theme uses alternate token set.
Localization: Toolbar accommodates +40% string length without layout break; labels collapse into secondary verbs (accessible tooltip) only when necessary.
ARIA: Toggle controls expose aria-pressed/aria-expanded appropriately; role and aria-labels present for icon-only buttons.
Screen reader: Activating 'Create rollout' announces new modal presence and first focusable field; variant state changes announce succinct status updates.
Design handoff: Figma prototype and annotated CSS spec pushed to Drive; engineers have an implementation checklist with test cases for keyboard and RTL.
design_notes: Introduce a compact mode layout that preserves linear DOM order (left-to-right in LTR, right-to-left in RTL) and uses a single focus trap when the toolbar opens a flyout/modal. Replace absolute-positioned labels with flow-layout components using flex-wrap; long labels collapse into an overflow menu with an accessible button (aria-haspopup="menu"). Use tokenized colors: focus-outline, focus-bg, disabled-opacity. Provide explicit min-widths for icon buttons to keep hit targets >= 44px.
accessibility_checklist: Ensure logical DOM order equals visual order for both LTR and RTL.
Add visible focus indicator (2px) that meets 3:1 contrast against adjacent UI per WCAG guidance for focus indicators.
Add aria-label for icon-only buttons and aria-hidden for purely decorative icons.
Avoid tabindex>0; use tabindex=0 for natural tab stops and manage focus programmatically only when opening modals.
Verify reduced-motion preference for toolbar animations.
Create screen reader announcements for dynamic operations using role=status or live region with polite/assertive as appropriate.
Add automated axe checks to the rollouts e2e tests for toolbar routes.
Document keyboard shortcuts and ensure they do not conflict with browser or OS-level shortcuts.
localization_checklist: Design uses token-based strings (no concatenation) and supports ICU pluralization for dynamic counts.
Reserve 40-60% extra horizontal space for translation expansion; fallback layout moves secondary labels into stacked view.
Test RTL: icon positions mirror and focus order flips to preserve reading direction; run Figma RTL variant review.
Avoid embedding punctuation into labels; provide separate tokens for labels and trailing punctuation/suffixes.
Expose data-i18n keys on interactive elements for QA harnesses and translation QA tools.
Ensure date/time in tooltips uses user locale and timezone from profile.
Provide QA checklist for translators: context notes, screenshot of expanded states, max-length guidance.
Stress-test with German and Japanese strings in prototype.
Confirm that CSS truncation does not hide semantic text needed by screen readers (use aria-labels when truncating visually).

decisions: Use flow-based DOM ordering; avoid tabindex manipulations except inside modals.
Use overflow 'More' menu for long translations when width < min threshold; include aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Focus ring uses token focus-outline (2px) with fallback focus-outline-high-contrast for HC theme.
Prefer aria-live='polite' for nonblocking variant status updates; use 'assertive' only for errors.
Localization team will provide sample German/Japanese strings and max-length guidance for engineering tests.
Implementation will include an automated visual diff step to catch token regressions in color themes.
